text: What happens in my body during sex?

steps.title: Heart picks up
steps.say: Around 21:45 your heart is near 95 beats a minute and blood pressure is higher, so more blood reaches your muscles and skin.

steps.title: Brain rewards
steps.say: Your brain releases feel-good chemicals, so you may feel relaxed and sleepy afterwards.

lines.text: Your heart speeds up and blood pressure rises, a bit like a brisk walk.
You burn more energy, and feel-good chemicals rise in your brain.
You may feel calm and drowsy afterwards, though tonight's coffee could keep you alert.
